title: Colonoscopic biopsy - sigmoid
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT

SPECIMEN: Colon, sigmoid (25 cm from AV), endoscopic biopsy x4
CLINICAL INFORMATION: 2.5 cm ulcerofungating mass at sigmoid colon. r/o malignancy.

GROSS: Received in formalin labelled with the patient's name and "sigmoid", four tan-pink soft tissue fragments, 0.2-0.4 cm. Entirely submitted in one cassette.

MICROSCOPIC: Sections show colonic mucosa infiltrated by irregular, cribriform glands lined by atypical columnar cells with enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei and dirty necrosis, invading into the lamina propria and muscularis mucosae.

DIAGNOSIS:
Colon, sigmoid, endoscopic biopsy:
  ADENOCARCINOMA, moderately differentiated.

COMMENT: MMR immunohistochemistry has been ordered and will be reported in an addendum.
